knowledge_graph.title: COVID-19 testing
knowledge_graph.description: COVID-19 testing involves analyzing samples to assess the current or past presence of SARS-CoV-2, the virus that causes COVID-19 and is responsible for the COVID-19 pandemic. The two main types of tests detect either the presence of the virus or antibodies produced in response to infection.

text_blocks.snippet: A COVID-19 test is a diagnostic tool used to detect an active SARS-CoV-2 infection. There are two main types of COVID-19 tests: molecular tests (like PCR) and antigen tests (rapid tests). Molecular tests, which are highly accurate, detect the virus's genetic material, while antigen tests detect viral proteins. Both types of tests help identify individuals who may be contagious and need to take precautions, like isolation, to prevent further spread.
